selection_note: The lead agent bounded this pass to four strongest candidates. Other leads are explicitly deferred or rejected, not silently treated as verified outcomes.

canonical_audit.local_instruction_search: No AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md found inside the target repository, including a hidden/no-ignore search under aipower.
canonical_audit.method: Inspected all event headings and relevant knowledge/medical records; searched event identifiers, titles, summaries, URLs and source entries for candidate names and study identifiers. Deduplication distinguishes events, study families and URL/DOI aliases. Existing future-dated records were used only for deduplication, never as verification of external facts.
canonical_audit.concurrent_work_note: The recorded SHA256 is the initial audit snapshot. Parallel v0.55 UI work changed canonical metadata and added crosscuttingViews during research. Final dedup and reference validation were rerun against the current graph; the event/source counts remained 567/837. No concurrent edits were reverted.

date_policy: Use an explicitly dated publication, release or correction. Distinguish first public disclosure, journal publication, testing period and later press coverage. Null source dates mean undated live documentation, not a date inferred from retrieval or a DOI string.

Организаторы публикуют решения, код, журналы и рецензии; качество изложения и ссылок оценивается отдельно.
candidates.summary_en: In First Proof Batch 3, ProofCouncil met the correctness threshold on 9 of 10 problems, GPT-6 Astra on 7, and the sole open-weight Kimi K3 system on none. Organizers publish solutions, code, logs and referee reports, with exposition and attribution scored separately.
candidates.caveat_ru: Задачи уже были решены людьми, но решения не публиковались. Порог допускает небольшие исправимые ошибки; это не формальная машинная проверка. Один открытый участник и разные программные оболочки не измеряют все открытые модели.
candidates.caveat_en: Humans had already solved these unpublished problems. The threshold permits minor repairable errors and is not formal verification. One open-weight entrant and differing harnesses cannot establish a result for all open models.
candidates.independent_replication: An external foundation ran and assessed the systems; this packet did not rerun them or independently prove the solutions.

candidates.caveat_en: Statistical validation is not independent confirmation by another observing method. The 118 are not all newly detected signals, and over 2,000 candidates must not be added to the planet count. Selection targets short-period systems under specific cuts.

integration_guardrails: Three proposed new study/evaluation families plus one material update; do not inflate the discovery count with press releases, datasets or revisions.
Preserve per-source verification limits. Indexed primary text can establish a bounded claim without implying that all methods, tables or protocols were reviewed.
Do not turn public code, a cloud app or an open paper into a claim of globally unrestricted practical access.
Do not sum overlapping astronomical catalogues without object-level deduplication.
Do not equate independent expert review, independent reanalysis and independent experimental replication.
No general productivity, GDP, clinical-benefit or national-sovereignty multiplier follows from these studies.
